utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What’s been gathered so far for the repair drive, and do you have the start time yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll keep an eye out for where they set up the repair drive and let you know the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Still waiting on the exact spot myself. I’ll pass it along as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what’s the first detail you want me to share?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Could you share the exact spot for the repair drive first? Just that one detail is enough, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still keeping an eye out for the exact spot, and I’ll let you know as soon as I see it. If you want, I can also pass along any details I hear about the drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — please do, and I’ll keep passing along any repair drive updates I hear while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the exact location and time for the repair drive, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — I’ll wait for the exact location and start time before I act.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got the running list of what we need for the repair drive—just tell me what’s been gathered so far, and I’ll keep you posted on the start time once I know it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve still only heard bits, but it sounds like the repair drive is moving along low-key. Once the start time’s set, I’ll repeat the plan to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if you need tools for the repair drive, I’ve got a few you can borrow. Just let me know what you’re fixing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I’m still just hearing bits second-hand, so I don’t know the exact repairs yet. I’ll let you know once I hear what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah — could you confirm the exact start time and meeting spot for the repair drive? I can bring whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—I can pass along the details, but I don’t have the exact start time or meeting spot on hand. If you want, I’ll check and send them over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, great—sounds like people are bringing in all sorts of useful stuff. If you want, I can keep you posted on what’s been gathered so far.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess—that would be really helpful. I’m still waiting on the exact spot and start time, so please do keep me posted.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Eli, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name down or swing by with the details?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Swing by with the details, please. I’ll keep an eye out and let you know the exact spot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still waiting on the exact time and spot for the repair drive, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I have it. Then I can tell you if you need to bring gloves or tape.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, I can borrow the tools if I need them, right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ve still got my running list, but I’m waiting on the exact time and meeting spot for the repair drive. Once I know that, I can tell you what to bring and keep track of the rest.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still watching for the exact spot, and I’ll pass it along as soon as it’s set.
